Remark
[a submersion metric on the tangent bundle]

Source: petersen:page-0289 ↗ def:pet-ch6-parallel-field 1. ch6:6.7.27Construct a Riemannian metric on $TM$ for a Riemannian manifold $(M,g)$ such that $\pi :TM\to M$ is a Riemannian submersion restricting to the given Euclidean metric on each fiber, by declaring parallel fields along curves in $M$ to give horizontal lifts.
